name: cartosym-draft-check
description: Checking the OGC CartoSym 2.0 draft requirements against an implementation: rendered judgement calls, sample renders and expression tests.

paragraphs: Checks the draft requirements for OGC Cartographic Symbology 2.0 Part 1 (and Part 2 gradient fills) proposed in opengeospatial/cartographic-symbology#133. The checks use an implementation, rendered output, and comparison with libCartoSym.

Requirements written without an implementation are hard to get right. This repository implements the draft, renders every place where the spec text leaves a behavior open, and runs the expression requirements through independent implementations. The goal is to show which requirements hold up, which are open questions, and where the spec's own examples disagree with the draft.

PR #133 has 134 requirements: 108 in Part 1's requirements files, 20 in the core class (clause 7) and 6 for Part 2 gradient fills. Every one is checked in at least one way; requirements.html lists how. Not implemented: the visualization time and capabilities system identifiers, and label maxSpacing. CSCSS .include and variables are checked through pycartosym's conversion, which since 0.5.0 gives the draft's $include, $variables and $ref form.
features: Rendered: vector styling (fill, stroke, units, markers, Dot, Text, Image), casing, dashes, hatches, stipples, dot patterns, font outlines, labels, coverage styling, hill shading and Part 2 gradients: judgement calls as…

Tested: arithmetic, math, text relation and manipulation, array relations, conditionals, right-hand operands, function calls, variables, and core literals, arrays and identifiers, in the test harness.
Encoding only: CSCSS and CartoSym-JSON encodings. The spec's examples are converted with pycartosym and parsed by libCartoSym.
